name: Spinosaurus (Saltwater)
label: Saltwater variant
title: Meeresbär
note: The Spinosaurus that prefers "a lazy lifestyle touring saltwater areas": a polar bear of the sea. It claims exactly one of the bright-green sea areas on the profile map (best Kelp Vale or the Coastal Bluffs) as its home, where it nests, defends and hunts players. From there it tours the Leedsichthys migration loop through foreign sea peacefully, hunting only fish, critters, Leedsichthys and Tylosaurus on the way, and drinks at fresh water it never defends. Shares the official Spinosaurus profile with the freshwater variant.
